messages:
anya: Hey team — spotted a weird line on INV-2026-0419 for NovaHealth. Two reserved-capacity rows for the same nodepool_id (np-az3-eu). One is labeled 'primary' and one 'replica', both billed for the same hour window. Can someone flag whether this is a metering dup or legit failover billing?
kevin: on it. Can you paste the invoice snippet or attach the meter export?
sarah: FYI this hit the NovaHealth account; they're pinging their CSM already. want to triage before I respond.
anya: pasted small snippet below — truncated.
```
invoice_line, nodepool_id, region, start_hour, end_hour, gpu_hours, rate_per_hour
L-98321, np-az3-eu, eu-west-1, 2026-03-12T03:00Z, 2026-03-12T04:00Z, 8.0, 2.20
L-98322, np-az3-eu (replica), eu-west-1, 2026-03-12T03:00Z, 2026-03-12T04:00Z, 8.0, 2.20
```
billing-bot: Metering export uploaded to /mnt/exports/novahealth/2026-03/meter-20260312.csv — checksum abc123.
kevin: thanks. quick check: are those two separate nodepool UUIDs under the hood or the same? sometimes failover pools get a suffix and we accidentally bill both.
oliver: infra note — there was an automatic failover at 03:07UTC in eu-west-1 due to host reboot. Our failover logic spun up the replica and didn't de-dupe prefix tags in the metering pipeline for that minute. looks like overlap equals ~55 minutes of double-counted KV.
kevin: rough calc: overlap = 8 gpu-hours (per line) => 8 * $2.20 * 1 duplicate = $17.60. Invoice shows two line items so total charged $35.20 for that hour.
jason: small amount but optics matter. Do we want to issue a provisional credit or absorb as goodwill? any vendor (cloud partner) liability?
oliver: partner-side telemetry shows the host was unhealthy and they billed for both instances transiently. Contract SOW says partner shares responsibility for metering accuracy on failover events if their host caused failover. We should open vendor claim.
kevin: propose: issue a provisional invoice credit for $17.60 now (CR-000789 provisional), open vendor dispute for recovery, and notify customer with transparent note + ETA. Approve?
sarah: approve on my side — keep message to customer: "we identified double-metering caused by failover, we've issued a provisional credit and are pursuing vendor recovery". want me to send note?
anya: yes please. include timeline: credit applied within 3 business days.
jason: can finance absorb provisional? routing to accounting — Kevin, I need one-liner justification and GL code.
kevin: justification: "provisional credit for duplicated metering due to failover; pending vendor recovery." GL code: COST_OF_SALES_CREDITS. tagging: partner-recovery.
oliver: I'll raise vendor support ticket VND-4421 and attach debug traces.
kevin: done — created credit CR-000789 for $17.60, applied to INV-2026-0419. Accounting notified.
sarah: sending customer note now. will cc ops and finance.
anya: thanks everyone. small ask: can eng add a short-term guard in metering pipeline to collapse identical nodepool_id+hour rows where role suffixes only differ? reduces noise for these cases.
oliver: yep adding a dedupe pass in the pipeline — patch ETA 48h. will post PR.
kevin: leaving a final trail: ticket FIN-2026-197 opened to track credit + vendor recovery. closing thread after Sarah's customer ack. :thumbsup:
sarah: customer acknowledged and thanked us for fast fix. :white_check_mark:
